name: Debo no Subako
source:
Debo no Subako is a fandisc for three [url=https://vndb.org/p17]Studio e.go![/url] games featuring new stories minigames and fanmaterials for each. 
Those games are:

•[url=https://vndb.org/v57464]Ama Kagura[/url]
•Suzume Kagura 雀神楽
•[url=https://vndb.org/v619]Izumo 0[/url] 
•[url=https://vndb.org/v106]Castle Fantasia 2: The Sacred War[/url]
